baseline.method: Checkout the published parent, apply the frozen publication patch and verify the full tree. The baseline is the exact prepared transfer-plan source, regardless of publication timing.

purpose: Classify every remaining real-corpus miss using canonical public operand details, including legacy SSE and 32-bit forms.
selection: The same frozen common iced/Capstone instruction-boundary extents and scalar/SIMD panel rules as native timing. Keep all histogram rows; this observes static corpus frequency, not application runtime frequency.
semantic_qualification: Reuse the completed R1375 semantic qualification; this observer checks monotonic admission and identity on the selected real corpus.
classification: Canonical ModR/M offset and memory operand fields identify register, ordinary base, indexed, IP-relative and absolute addressing. Legacy family is 0x10000 | opcode map; VEX/EVEX family retains prefix-length/map encoding. This is a static corpus observer, never a native timing consumer.
legacy_prefix: The legacy pp field records the last raw 66/F3/F2 prefix before the opcode; it is a census label, not a replacement decoder.
